# 01-开发者配置中心

## ① 模块概述

### 业务目标
为系统管理员提供统一的配置管理中心，管理人才盘点系统运行所需的基础数据配置，包括评估维度体系、岗位能力标准、周期创建规则、情景测试题库、绩效评估体系、AI访谈配置、AI提示词配置。

### 核心功能
- 评估维度体系配置（管理评估模板、评估项目、评分标准，自评/上级评/下级评/同级评关系勾选）
- 岗位能力标准配置（胜任力模型L1-L5级别定义，支持提交JD内容通过 AI 智能生成评价维度）
- 周期创建规则配置（笔试/互评时长、报告生成时间、自动关联盘点项目、下发范围及必考环节配置）
- SJTP情景测试题库管理（支持Excel模板下载与批量导入、场景分类、状态启用/禁用、推荐答案高亮标记）
- 绩效评估体系配置（动态维度添加、权重设置、评分标准及 S/A/B/C/D 绩效等级分数区间划分）
- AI访谈模板管理（新建/导入/编辑/删除模板、大类及二级问题维度与权重配置、预设引导问题）
- AI提示词配置（集中管理 SJTP 测评分析、AI 访谈评估、报告总结生成等节点的大模型 Prompt）
- 360°胜任力指标配置（自定义专业知识、主动性、团队协作等 360 互评核心指标的文本定义及 1-5 分制标准）

### 在整体业务流程中的定位
开发者配置中心是系统业务流程的**前置准备环节**，为后续所有测评模块提供基础配置数据。所有评估标准、题库、模板均需在此配置后方可使用。

### 上游来源模块
无（系统初始配置，由超管/人事手动录入或通过 AI 智能生成）

### 下游关联模块
| 模块名称 | 输出数据 | 使用方式 |
|---------|---------|---------|
| 绩效评估 | 动态考评维度与权重配置、等级标准 | 绩效评估打分时按配置的权重计算总分，并映射至对应等级|
| 情景测试 | SJTP题库 | 员工答题时从题库抽取题目 |
| AI深度访谈 | 访谈模板、问题维度与引导语 | 发起访谈时按模板与维度轮次生成 AI 问题并指导追问 |
| 盘点报告生成| AI提示词配置（测评、访谈、总结） | 运行 AI 分析时，调用对应的 Prompt 策略由大模型生成总结报告 |
｜360°评估｜胜任力核心指标体系与评价关系权重｜360模块在项目启动时调用此指标库生成互评表单，并依据此处配置的自评/上下级/同级权重计算综合互评分｜

---

## ② 功能描述

### 模块用途
集中管理人才盘点系统的各项配置参数和基础数据，确保各评估模块有据可依。

### 业务价值
- 统一配置入口，避免配置分散导致的数据不一致
- 支持灵活调整评估标准和题库，适应不同盘点周期需求
- 保障系统可扩展性，新增评估维度或题型无需改动代码

### 用户操作目标
- 配置360°评估模板的要素、分值及自评/上级/下级/同级评估关系。
- 维护各组织岗位的能力标准行为描述，或输入岗位JD由AI自动提取能力维度。
- 新建或启用季度、半年度、年度等考核周期规则，定义各环节时间表与必考模块。
- 检索、下载Excel文件模板、批量上传Excel题库、启用/禁用SJTP情景测试题目。
- 动态调整绩效评估的控制维度、比率权重、打分标准，并圈定S/A/B/C/D等级分界线。
- 新增、导入、编辑AI访谈问题结构及其对应维度的权重。
- 调优针对GPT-4o模型的评估分析、访谈打分及总结生成的底层Prompts提示词。

### 功能边界
- **权限边界**：本模块仅对超级管理员及具备特殊授权的组织HR专家角色开放，普通员工与部门管理人员无权访问。
- **动态时效边界**：配置与提示词的变更采取“新任务新办法”原则，仅对变更后新发起的盘点周期、考核任务、AI访谈生效；当前处于“进行中”或“已归档”的盘点数据和报告不受影响。

---

## ③ 界面原型

### 页面布局结构
页面采用左侧Tab导航 + 右侧内容区的布局模式。

### 区域划分
- **顶部Tab导航区**：水平排列7个核心业务Tab，当前激活项高亮显示。Tab依次为：`评估维度体系`、`岗位能力标准`、`周期创建规则`、`情景测试题库`、`绩效评估体系`、`AI访谈配置`、`AI提示词配置`。
- **页面次级标头区**：展示当前Tab的模块二级标题、功能简述，以及右侧高亮的全局操作按...

review_items: [高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-001: The system must restrict developer configuration center access to only super administrators and organization HR experts; unauthorized users attempting to access via URL manipulation must be redirected to a 403 error page. (源自事实: FACT-016, FACT-096)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-002: The system must enforce data visibility isolation in personnel architecture management: super admin/HR sees all company data, department leaders see only their department and subordinates, and regular employees cannot access the module. (源自事实: FACT-104)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-003: The system must mask supervisor evaluation score details from department leaders in 360° evaluation, outputting only weighted department averages at the code level to ensure privacy protection. (源自事实: FACT-166, FACT-169)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-004: The system must protect regular employees' 360° evaluation scoring privacy so that no other user can view their specific individual scores to any particular person. (源自事实: FACT-167)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-005: The performance comprehensive report module must execute three-tier data permission hard isolation: super admin has full data access, department leaders can only view their department, and regular employees can only view their own report. (源自事实: FACT-173)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-006: The system must implement three-level permission monitoring panels in the inventory task plan: super admin sees global and personal data with all operation buttons; department leaders see only their department's task tree with edit/delete hidden; regular employees see only their own task cards with the 'go to assessment' control. (源自事实: FACT-127, FACT-130)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-010: The system must validate that the sum of all dynamic dimension weights in the performance evaluation system strictly equals 100%; if the sum does not equal 100%, the system must abort saving and display a global red warning popup with all weight input boxes highlighted. (源自事实: FACT-061, FACT-086)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-015: The system must validate via regex that the AI prompt text retains the two required system placeholder variables {user_data} and {interview_text}; if either is missing, the system must reject saving and prompt about missing core data placeholders. (源自事实: FACT-069, FACT-092)
[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-028: The system must check whether an employee is currently participating in an evaluation before allowing deletion of their record. (源自事实: FACT-113)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-029: When a cycle creation rule is enabled and an associated project in module 04 is activated or reaches start time, the system must calculate the final participant list by intersecting bound positions with the personnel level scope and batch-insert into the personal assessment task table. (源自事实: FACT-078)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-031: When mandatory assessment module combinations are edited (e.g., adding AI interview), the system must dynamically update the task table structure mapping, auto-add columns to monitoring popups, and insert new tasks into employee to-do plans. (源自事实: FACT-079)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-032: When a project reaches its assessment start time and triggers batch distribution, the system must generate a project-specific participant snapshot from the current latest organizational architecture; all subsequent scoring and reminders must reference this snapshot. (源自事实: FACT-134)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-034: When the server system time reaches the project's assessment end time (to the second), the system must automatically lock and close all employee-side submission, testing, and interview entry points. (源自事实: FACT-136)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-035: For 360° evaluation timeout handling, the system must mark unsubmitted peer questionnaires as void and calculate the employee's 360° final score using weighted average of only the submitted valid questionnaires. (源自事实: FACT-137)

[高风险需人工确认] ASSERT-036: For scenario test/AI interview timeout handling, the system must force-submit in-progress submissions and send partial context to the AI engine for scoring; for not-started items, the status must be set to timeout with a score of 0. (源自事实: FACT-138)
